submitted.rationale: Index 18 (Mn0.51Y0.49) gave the highest measured photocurrent, 1.6e-7 A. It sits at the YMnO3 stoichiometry. Photocurrent dropped on both sides: 8e-8 A at Mn 0.41 and 1e-8 A at Mn 0.79. XRD on indices 10, 18, 23 and 3 showed the same single peak near Q 2.78, so it did not tell the compositions apart.

rejected.reason: Not measured. The GP predicted it lower than index 18, and its XRD peak was shifted, pointing to the Mn-rich side where photocurrent falls off
